items.question: Which applicants can apply online through the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research's National Unified Registration System for higher education admission in the UAE?
items.gold: Emirati students and children of Emirati women.
items.fact: National Unified Registration System eligibility: Emirati students and children of Emirati women

items.question: What can a recognition report from the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research's University Qualifications Recognition service be used for?
items.gold: It serves as an official document for employment, further studies, visas and government services in the UAE.
items.fact: Qualifications recognition report serves as official document for several purposes
